title: Cross-mailbox Copy
blurb: Move / Copy to other mailbox… keeps the clicked messages or the full reviewed selection, including hidden rows, while navigating elsewhere. Choose a connected receiving mailbox to check its current capabilities and folders; unavailable folders remain visible with reasons. Copy retains every source message. Gmail API sources may then use the separate reviewed Gmail Move flow; other connected source providers remain Copy-only. Local and connected sources use the same reviewed Copy flow. Press Copy to review the exact count, owning source mailboxes, receiving mailbox and folder, and provider preservation notices; only the final Copy messages confirmation can upload. Opening, checking support, reviewing or cancelling never sends mail or creates a folder. Gmail OAuth import uses the original valid Date header for sorting; Gmail may classify or group mail and add labels. Outlook, Yahoo and generic IMAP are enabled only when the host verifies persistent UIDPLUS or IMAP4rev2 UIDs, full readback, flags and date support. Complete original headers, bodies, every inline/file attachment, and read/star state must be verified; provider behavior is not identical. Connected Copy accepts at most 50 messages and 32 MiB per original message, with 256 MiB total per review. Local Folders keeps its separate 200-message / 64 MiB server-original limits. Source, destination, folder, action and mailbox connection are rechecked after asynchronous work; reconnects, stale sources, changed choices and expired reviews require another review. Unread/total count refreshes and unrelated folder changes keep the review; changes to the selected receiving folder or its ancestors’ identity or permissions require a fresh review. Each exact reviewed source uses the same host ticket for one sequential commit. Verified existing copies count only after fresh host verification. Stop after this message or Escape stops remaining work after the current upload finishes and cannot recall a started upload. Unknown results stop the batch, retain sources, warn that the destination may contain a copy and block automatic retry; check the destination before further action. Failures, timeouts, closing, reopening and restart never automatically replay an upload. Unused reviews are retired on changed choices or close. Copy cannot authorize source removal; Gmail API Move requires its separate Trash review. No hidden folder creation, outgoing send, drag transfer, bot operation or CLI command is available. Synthetic DOM and actual Chromium checks do not certify native Windows/macOS, live providers, real power-loss recovery or screen-reader behavior.
